summary_en: 440,000 shares (2.34% of S/O) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 at ¥850/share, upper limit ¥374.0M. Single trading session order on June 12, 2026, 08:45 JST. Partial or full cancellation of order possible depending on market conditions.
title_en: Notice of Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Treasury Stock Off-Exchange Purchase Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On June 11, 2026, Toell Co., Ltd. (ticker 3361, TSE Standard) announced execution of a single-block treasury stock acquisition via ToSTNeT-3 (off-exchange trading). The company will place a buy order for up to 440,000 shares at the closing price of ¥850/share on June 11, with settlement occurring during the ToSTNeT-3 session on June 12 at 08:45 JST. The maximum expenditure is ¥374.0M (¥850 × 440,000 shares). The block represents 2.34% of shares outstanding (ex-treasury base of 18,723,926 shares as of May 31, 2026). The order is valid for that single trading session only; partial or complete cancellation is possible if market conditions warrant. Stated rationale: flexible capital policy responsive to changing business conditions and improved capital efficiency.
